summary.text: Lea Webb is a Democratic state senator who represents New York State Senate District 52 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Webb, a former Binghamton city council member and university educator, has been a state senator since 2023 and is the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate.

paragraphs.text: Lea Webb was born in New York and earned a B.S. in psychology from Binghamton University in 2004.
Her career experience includes working as an educator at Binghamton University, and she was appointed to serve on the Binghamton city council.
Webb also co-founded the Black Millennial Political Convention and was a founding board member of Local Progress.
Webb has represented State Senate District 52 since 2023, succeeding Fred Akshar (R).
In the 2025-2026 session she chairs the Women's Issues Committee and is also assigned to the Health, Mental Health, Procurement and Contracts, Agriculture, Cities 2, and Higher Education committees.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Webb faces Mike Bolles (R / Conservative Party).
